paragraphs.zh: The present invention relates to two crystalline forms of 2-[2-chloro-4-methylsulfonyl-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxymethyl)benzoyl]cyclohexan-1,3-dione, which is also known under the common name tembotrione. The invention also relates to a process for the production of these crystalline forms and formulations for plant protection which contain one of these crystalline forms of tembotrione.
paragraphs.en: The present invention relates to two crystalline forms of 2-[2-chloro-4-methylsulfonyl-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxymethyl)benzoyl]cyclohexan-1,3-dione, which is also known under the common name tembotrione. The invention also relates to a process for the production of these crystalline forms and formulations for plant protection which contain one of these crystalline forms of tembotrione.
paragraphs.notes: Source language is English, so en repeats zh unchanged. The name is printed broken across two lines as '(2,2,2-trifluoro-' / 'ethoxymethyl)'; that end-of-line hyphen is typesetting hyphenation inside the single word 'trifluoroethoxymethyl' and has been closed up. Text layer damage repaired from the image: '2-2-chloro' -> '2-[2-chloro', 'benzoylcyclohexan' -> 'benzoyl]cyclohexan' (both square brackets were lost), '(2.2.2-' -> '(2,2,2-', 'oftembotrione' -> 'of tembotrione'.

paragraphs.zh: Tembotrione is the herbicidal active substance of the formula I or the tautomers I' and I" and mixtures thereof.
paragraphs.en: Tembotrione is the herbicidal active substance of the formula I or the tautomers I' and I" and mixtures thereof.
paragraphs.notes: In the body text the two tautomer labels are printed with a straight apostrophe and a straight double quote, I' and I", and are transcribed with those characters. The formula labels beside the drawings use typographic prime and double-prime glyphs instead, (I') and (I"); see the drawings entries. The text layer rendered the pair as 'I" and I"', which loses the distinction between one prime and two; the image settles it as one prime then two. The three formulae drawn immediately below this paragraph are recorded in drawings[].

paragraphs.zh: Tembotrione and a general procedure for its production are known from WO 00/21924. This procedure yields tembotrione as an oil or as an amorphous solid. A liquid formulation of tembotrione with isoxadifen was recently introduced onto the market.
paragraphs.en: Tembotrione and a general procedure for its production are known from WO 00/21924. This procedure yields tembotrione as an oil or as an amorphous solid. A liquid formulation of tembotrione with isoxadifen was recently introduced onto the market.
paragraphs.notes: Prior-art citation. 'WO 00/21924' checked digit by digit on the image at high magnification: W, O, space, two zeros, solidus, 2, 1, 9, 2, 4. The two characters after 'WO ' are digit zeros, not letter O, and the text layer happens to agree here. This is the only prior-art document cited on the page.

paragraphs.zh: For the production of active substances on the industrial scale but also for the formulation of active substances, in many cases knowledge concerning the possible existence of crystalline modifications (also described as crystalline forms) or of solvates of the active substance in question, and knowledge of the specific properties of such modifications and solvates and of methods for their preparation are of decisive importance. A range of active substances can exist in different crystalline but also in amorphous modifications. Polymorphism is the term used in these cases. A polymorph is a solid, crystalline phase of a compound which is characterized by a specific, uniform packing and arrangement of the molecules in the solid.
paragraphs.en: For the production of active substances on the industrial scale but also for the formulation of active substances, in many cases knowledge concerning the possible existence of crystalline modifications (also described as crystalline forms) or of solvates of the active substance in question, and knowledge of the specific properties of such modifications and solvates and of methods for their preparation are of decisive importance. A range of active substances can exist in different crystalline but also in amorphous modifications. Polymorphism is the term used in these cases. A polymorph is a solid, crystalline phase of a compound which is characterized by a specific, uniform packing and arrangement of the molecules in the solid.
paragraphs.notes: Text layer damage repaired from the image: it capitalised 'Solvates', 'Substance', 'Such' and 'Substances' mid-sentence, and ran 'can existin different' together. The image shows lower case throughout and a normal word space. Line-break hyphens closed in 'indus-trial', 'knowl-edge' and 'Polymor-phism'.

paragraphs.zh: Different modifications of one and the same active substance can sometimes have different properties, for example differences in the following properties: solubility, vapor pressure, dissolution rate, stability against a phase change into a different modification, stability during grinding, suspension stability, optical and mechanical properties, hygroscopicity, crystal form and size, filterability, density, melting point, stability to decomposition, color and sometimes even chemical reactivity or biological activity.
paragraphs.en: Different modifications of one and the same active substance can sometimes have different properties, for example differences in the following properties: solubility, vapor pressure, dissolution rate, stability against a phase change into a different modification, stability during grinding, suspension stability, optical and mechanical properties, hygroscopicity, crystal form and size, filterability, density, melting point, stability to decomposition, color and sometimes even chemical reactivity or biological activity.
paragraphs.notes: This paragraph runs off the foot of the left column ('optical and mechanical properties,') and continues at the head of the right column ('hygroscopicity, crystal form and size, ...'); recorded as the one paragraph it is. Line-break hyphens closed in 'Sub-stance' [printed 'substance'], 'grind-ing' and 'some-times'. Text layer capitalised 'Substance'; the image shows lower case.

paragraphs.zh: The applicant’s own attempts to convert tembotrione into a crystalline solid by crystallization at first resulted in amorphous products or in complex mixtures of different crystal modifications, which could only be handled with difficulty and whose stability against uncontrolled phase change was unsatisfactory.
paragraphs.en: The applicant's own attempts to convert tembotrione into a crystalline solid by crystallization at first resulted in amorphous products or in complex mixtures of different crystal modifications, which could only be handled with difficulty and whose stability against uncontrolled phase change was unsatisfactory.
paragraphs.notes: zh keeps the typographic apostrophe in 'applicant’s' as printed; en normalises it to a plain ASCII apostrophe. That is the only difference between the two fields. Line-break hyphens closed in 'tembotri-one', 'crys-tal' and 'unsatis-factory'.

paragraphs.zh: It has now surprisingly been found that by suitable processes two previously unknown crystalline, stable modifications of tembotrione which do not display the disadvantages of the amorphous tembotrione are obtained in high purity. These two modifications are also described below as form A and form C.
paragraphs.en: It has now surprisingly been found that by suitable processes two previously unknown crystalline, stable modifications of tembotrione which do not display the disadvantages of the amorphous tembotrione are obtained in high purity. These two modifications are also described below as form A and form C.
paragraphs.notes: The two crystalline modifications of the invention are named form A and form C on this page. There is no form B anywhere on the page; the naming skips B without comment, and nothing on p04 explains it. Text layer damage repaired: 'oftembotrione' -> 'of tembotrione'. Line-break hyphens closed in 'modi-fications' and 'disadvan-tages'.

paragraphs.zh: In addition, the crystal forms A and C according to the invention are easier to handle than the previously known amorphous tembotrione, since during production they are obtained in the form of discrete crystals or crystallites. Compared to mixtures of these forms both the pure form A and also the pure form C display increased stability with regard to conversion into another modification. The stability of formulations which contain tembotrione either in form A or form C is also markedly higher than the stability of formulations which contain mixtures of different modifications of tembotrione. The terms “pure form A” and “pure form C” should be understood to mean that the proportion of the modification in question, based on the total quantity of tembotrione, is at least 90 wt. % and in particular at least 95 wt. %.
paragraphs.en: In addition, the crystal forms A and C according to the invention are easier to handle than the previously known amorphous tembotrione, since during production they are obtained in the form of discrete crystals or crystallites. Compared to mixtures of these forms both the pure form A and also the pure form C display increased stability with regard to conversion into another modification. The stability of formulations which contain tembotrione either in form A or form C is also markedly higher than the stability of formulations which contain mixtures of different modifications of tembotrione. The terms "pure form A" and "pure form C" should be understood to mean that the proportion of the modification in question, based on the total quantity of tembotrione, is at least 90 wt. % and in particular at least 95 wt. %.
paragraphs.notes: zh keeps the typographic quotation marks around “pure form A” and “pure form C” as printed; en normalises them to plain ASCII double quotes. Both closing marks were checked on the image and are true closing double quotes; the text layer had turned the first one into a single apostrophe and dropped the second altogether. 'wt. %' is printed with a space after the full stop, twice, and both are kept. The percentages are 90 and 95, read off the image. Line-break hyphens closed in 'Com-pared', 'formu-lations' and 'tembot-rione'.

paragraphs.zh: Accordingly, a first object of the present invention relates to the crystalline form A of tembotrione. Also an object is a tembotrione which at least 90 wt. % in particular at least 95% consists of the crystalline form A.
paragraphs.en: Accordingly, a first object of the present invention relates to the crystalline form A of tembotrione. Also an object is a tembotrione which at least 90 wt. % in particular at least 95% consists of the crystalline form A.
paragraphs.notes: Printed exactly as transcribed, including the ungrammatical 'a tembotrione which at least 90 wt. % in particular at least 95% consists of', which reads as a missing 'to'. Not corrected. Note the inconsistency in the source itself, checked twice on the image: the first figure is printed '90 wt. %' with a unit, the second '95%' with no 'wt.' and no space, inside the same sentence.

paragraphs.zh: Studies on single crystals of form A demonstrate that the underlying crystal structure is orthorhombic. The unit cell has the space group Pna2(1). The characteristic data of the crystal structure of form A (determined at -170° C.) are compiled in the following table.
paragraphs.en: Studies on single crystals of form A demonstrate that the underlying crystal structure is orthorhombic. The unit cell has the space group Pna2(1). The characteristic data of the crystal structure of form A (determined at -170° C.) are compiled in the following table.
paragraphs.notes: Last paragraph on the page. The table it announces is NOT on this page: the right column ends here and the table of unit-cell data must be on p05, so no rows for it are recorded here. The space group is printed 'Pna2(1)', with the 1 in parentheses standing for the subscript in Pna2_1; transcribed as printed. The minus in '-170° C.' is printed as an en dash and is transcribed as a plain ASCII hyphen. '(1)' and '2' checked on the image so the space group is not corrupted by the OCR habit of reading 1 as l.

This is one of a set of three structures drawn one under another between [0002] and [0003]; (I), (I') and (I") are recorded as three separate drawings entries so each keeps its own printed formula label, but they are one tautomer set and paragraph [0002] presents them as such. drawings.notes: Formula (I'), an enol tautomer, and the drawing settles it without ambiguity, so a SMILES is given. Which oxygen carries the H: the oxygen on ring carbon C3, the lower of the two ring oxygens as drawn, which is labelled 'OH' in full rather than as a bare O. Which bond is drawn double: the endocyclic C2=C3 bond, two clearly separated parallel lines checked at 6x. Which carbonyl is enolised: a RING carbonyl, the one at C3; the other ring carbonyl at C1 is still drawn C=O and the exocyclic benzoyl C=O is untouched. So (I') differs from (I) by moving the C2 hydrogen of (I) onto the C3 oxygen and making C2=C3 double. Confidence is high because both the OH label and the doubled ring edge are legible and separated; there is no place where a guess was needed. Aryl half is identical to (I), substituent for substituent, checked independently on this drawing and not copied from (I). The text layer gave 'O / O / C / o1 Ner, / O / OH / sa / M \, / O CH' for this structure; only the 'OH' survived in it, and even that carries no position. SMILES hand-checked: C17H16ClF3O6S, same formula as (I) as a tautomer must be. See the (I) entry for the presented_as caveat.

drawings.notes: Formula (I"), the other enol tautomer, and this drawing is also unambiguous, so a SMILES is given. Which oxygen carries the H: the EXOCYCLIC oxygen, the one on the former benzoyl carbon, labelled 'OH' at the top of the drawing between the ring and the Cl. Which bond is drawn double: the EXOCYCLIC C2=C bond between ring carbon C2 and that carbon, two clearly separated parallel lines checked at 6x. Which carbonyl is enolised: the exocyclic one; both ring carbonyls at C1 and C3 are still drawn C=O, which is the visible difference from (I') and the reason the two enols cannot be confused. So (I") differs from (I) by moving the C2 hydrogen of (I) onto the exocyclic oxygen and making the exocyclic bond double. GEOMETRY NOT RECORDED IN THE SMILES: the exocyclic C=C is drawable as E or Z and the drawing does show one particular planar arrangement, with the OH on the same side as the C1 ring carbonyl (consistent with an intramolecular hydrogen bond, though the page draws no such bond). Nothing in the text designates E or Z, so the SMILES is written without double-bond stereochemistry rather than asserting a configuration the patent does not claim. Connectivity is high confidence; the configuration is deliberately left unspecified and is called out here so it is not mistaken for an omission. The text layer gave 'O / OH / Cl / 21 / o1 Ner, / / Yh / 3'; the stray '21' and '3' are fragments of the drawing, not text. SMILES hand-checked: C17H16ClF3O6S, same formula as (I) and (I'). See the (I) entry for the presented_as caveat.

notes: First page of the description of US 2010/0041557 A1 (BASF SE, published Feb. 18, 2010), two-column layout. The page carries the title, paragraphs [0001] to [0011], the three drawn formulae (I), (I') and (I") between [0002] and [0003], and one unlabelled two-column table of X-ray powder diffraction reflections for form A between [0010] and [0011]. Language: English throughout. Per the run briefing the printed English is placed verbatim in zh, because build_enriched.py reads that key by name, and the same text appears in en; the only paragraphs where the two differ are [0006] and [0008], where en normalises the typographic apostrophe and quotation marks to ASCII. Every line count in zh matches its en so resolve_translations.py pairs them line for line, and no zh or en field contains a blank line. header/footer: the running head is 'US 2010/0041557 A1' at the left and 'Feb. 18, 2010' at the right, with the page number '1' centred just below it; page_label carries that '1'. No footer is printed at all, so footer is the empty string, which is a finding and not an omission. Line-break hyphenation: this page is justified and hyphenates heavily; in every case the hyphen falls inside a single word and has been closed up, and each affected paragraph's notes list the words. No hyphen internal to a chemical name was removed. Em dashes: the page prints an em dash between 'Cu' and 'Kα' in [0010] and an en dash as the minus sign in '-170° C.' in [0011]; the repo forbids the em dash character anywhere, so both are transcribed as plain ASCII hyphens and both substitutions are recorded in the paragraph notes. Nothing on the page was illegible; page_confidence is high, and the worst part of the page is the exocyclic C=C configuration in (I"), which is legible but undesignated by the patent and so deliberately left out of the SMILES rather than guessed. PROVENANCE: this vision read was produced by Claude Opus 5 (model id claude-opus-5[1m]) reading runs/US20100041557A1/input/pages/p04.png directly, with /tmp/us2010/page04.txt used only as a cross-check. Every structure was re-read from crops magnified 3x to 6x before any SMILES was written, and no SMILES was validated by RDKit or OPSIN because neither is available in this environment; all three were checked by hand, atom by atom and bond by bond, against the drawing and against the molecular formula C17H16ClF3O6S. CROP HYGIENE: the shared scratchpad was reported to collide between page agents, with generic crop names (hdr.png and the like) written by several agents at once on a case-insensitive filesystem, so a crop could be read back carrying another page's ink with no error raised. On this page that failure would have produced a confident, plausible, wrong tautomer reading with nothing to flag it. Every crop this read depends on was therefore re-cut into a directory unique to this agent, /tmp/us2010/v_p04/, under names prefixed p04_, and re-read there from scratch before anything was trusted: p04_ring_I, p04_ring_Ip and p04_ring_Ipp at 6x for the three dione/enol rings, p04_aryl_Ip and p04_aryl_Ipp at 5x so the aryl half of each tautomer was read on its own drawing rather than assumed to repeat (I), and p04_markers at 3x for the paragraph markers. All nine files in that directory have distinct md5 sums, and the re-read agreed with the first read on every bond in all three structures: (I) saturated ring with two C=O and an H at C2, (I') ring C1=O with C2=C3 and C3-OH, (I") both ring C=O intact with the exocyclic C2=C(OH)Ar. No reading in this file rests on a crop written under a generic name.
